explication: SmartKnob is a configurable haptic input device: firmware reads knob motion and applies motor torque to create detents and endstops, while hosts configure behavior and consume state over USB serial. Its main runtime path runs from hardware initialization through sensor/motor control and display feedback, with serial protocol linking firmware to browser, Node, CLI, and Python integrations. README documents additional press sensing and automatic lighting, but those paths are not evident in the sampled implementation, so they are not expanded here.
